extName.message: Web Crawler - Spider on Web Pages

extDescription.message: A mechanical spider that really crawls web pages. Turn on virus mode to infect page elements, like a computer bug from the movies.

uiFail.message: Verification failed, check your key or network

optSub.message: Settings for the spider that crawls web pages

optEnableDesc.message: Stops every tab instantly and restores the page

optCountPro.message: Pro allows up to 6 spiders at once

optModeDesc.message: Virus mode randomly recolors, scales and rotates elements it passes

optFollowDesc.message: Auto-scrolls when the spider reaches the edge, so it roams the whole document

optTrailDesc.message: Leave a faint thread behind the spider

optSoundDesc.message: Footstep ticks, infection zaps and spawn cues — all synthesized locally; toggle anytime

optVirusNote.message: In virus mode, text near the spider gets randomly highlighted, scaled, rotated or letter-spaced, then restores automatically. Page structure and data are never touched.

optVirusRestoreDesc.message: Restore every element in all tabs at once

optRestoreDone.message: Restore signal sent to all tabs

optSitesNote.message: The spider will not start on these domains (banking, exams, password managers…). Enter the bare domain, no http prefix.

optLicFree.message: Free: 1 spider, 1 skin, basic virus effect

optBuyNote.message: Pro is coming soon: a license key will unlock 6 spiders, all skins and full-strength virus effects.

optPrivacyDesc.message: This extension collects no browsing data

optCreditDesc.message: Slava Rybin's (@rybinfx) viral "Web crawlers" clip — this extension is an independent implementation.

optAboutNote.message: All animation is rendered locally: no tracking, no analytics, no data collection. Your license key and a random device ID are sent only when you choose to verify a key.
